object.script:
local mainEnable = false local frontRequest = false
local raiseCmd = false local pantographUp = false
local prevMain = false local prevFront = false
local sequenceOK = false local orderViolation = false local dropLock = false
function onTick() mainEnable = input.getBool(1) frontRequest = input.getBool(2)
local mainOn = mainEnable and not prevMain local mainOff = not mainEnable and prevMain local frontOn = frontRequest and not prevFront local frontOff = not frontRequest and prevFront if frontOn and not mainEnable then orderViolation = true sequenceOK = false end if mainEnable and frontOn and not orderViolation then sequenceOK = true end if mainOff and frontRequest and pantographUp then dropLock = true orderViolation = true end if frontOff and pantographUp then if not dropLock then pantographUp = false sequenceOK = false end end if sequenceOK and mainEnable and frontRequest then pantographUp = true end if not mainEnable and not frontRequest then dropLock = false orderViolation = false sequenceOK = false end if pantographUp then raiseCmd = true else raiseCmd = false end prevMain = mainEnable prevFront = frontRequest
output.setBool(1, raiseCmd) end
